name: Stench
description: By releasing a stench when attacking, there is a 10% chance that targets damaged by the Pokémon’s moves will flinch. This does not stack with moves or items that have a chance to flinch.

name: Drizzle
description: Summons rain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle. Powers up Water-type moves by 50% and halves the damage of Fire-type moves.

name: Speed Boost
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat at the end of every turn.

name: Battle Armor
description: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

name: Sturdy
description: If the Pokémon has full HP and takes damage from a move that would knock it out in one hit, it will endure the hit with 1 HP. The Pokémon is also immune to one-hit KO moves.

name: Damp
description: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct or dealing damage with Aftermath.

name: Limber
description: The Pokémon’s limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.

name: Sand Veil
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s evasiveness by 25% in a sandstorm. The Pokémon also takes no damage from sandstorms.

name: Static
description: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and has a 30% chance to paralyze attackers that hit it with a contact move.

name: Volt Absorb
description: Electric-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.

name: Water Absorb
description: Water-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.

name: Oblivious
description: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

name: Cloud Nine
description: Eliminates the effects of weather.

name: Compound Eyes
description: The Pokémon’s compound eyes boost its accuracy by 30%.

name: Insomnia
description: The Pokémon’s insomnia prevents it from becoming drowsy or being put to sleep.

name: Color Change
description: The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.

name: Immunity
description: The Pokémon’s immune system prevents it from being poisoned or badly poisoned.

name: Flash Fire
description: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves by 50%.

name: Shield Dust
description: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

name: Own Tempo
description: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

name: Suction Cups
description: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.

name: Intimidate
description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

name: Shadow Tag
description: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon’s shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

name: Rough Skin
description: The Pokémon’s rough skin damages attackers that hit it with contact moves for 1/8 of their max HP.

name: Wonder Guard
description: Its mysterious power only lets super effective moves hit the Pokémon.

name: Levitate
description: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web.

name: Effect Spore
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned, paralyzed, or put to sleep. Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected.

name: Synchronize
description: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, poisoned, or badly poisoned by another Pokémon’s move or Ability, that Pokémon will also be inflicted with the same status condition. If this Pokémon is your lead into battle, opposing wild Pokémon will share its nature.

name: Clear Body
description: The Pokémon’s stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities.

name: Natural Cure
description: The Pokémon’s status conditions are cured when it switches out of battle.

name: Lightning Rod
description: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. These moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Sp. Atk stat.

name: Serene Grace
description: Doubles the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves. This does not affect items.

name: Swift Swim
description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat in rain.

name: Chlorophyll
description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

name: Illuminate
description: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered and ignores changes to targets’ evasiveness. Raises the likelihood of Double Battles while this Pokémon is on the field.

name: Trace
description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it changes its Ability to match that of an opponent.

name: Huge Power
description: Doubles the power of the Pokémon’s physical moves.

name: Poison Point
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

name: Inner Focus
description: The Pokémon’s intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

name: Magma Armor
description: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.

name: Water Veil
description: The Pokémon’s water veil prevents it from being burned.

name: Magnet Pull
description: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.

name: Soundproof
description: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

name: Rain Dish
description: The Pokémon has 1/16 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn in rain.

name: Sand Stream
description: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle. Pokémon that are not Rock, Ground, or Steel types take damage equal to 1/16 of their max HP at the end of every turn. This also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types by 50%.

name: Pressure
description: Puts opposing Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend 1 more PP when using moves against the Pokémon.

name: Thick Fat
description: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

name: Early Bird
description: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

name: Flame Body
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being burned.

name: Run Away
description: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon, as well as ignoring any effect that would usually prevent the Pokémon from switching out.

name: Keen Eye
description: The Pokémon’s keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered and ignore changes to targets’ evasiveness.

name: Hyper Cutter
description: The Pokémon’s prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering its Attack stat.

name: Pickup
description: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle, even if it did not participate.

name: Truant
description: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.

name: Hustle
description: When the Pokémon uses physical moves, its Attack stat is boosted by 50%, but its accuracy is lowered by 20%.

name: Cute Charm
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of becoming infatuated if the attacker and the Pokémon are of opposite genders.

name: Plus
description: The Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 50% if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

name: Minus
description: The Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 50% if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

name: Forecast
description: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.

name: Sticky Hold
description: The Pokémon’s held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be stolen or removed by other Pokémon.

name: Shed Skin
description: The Pokémon has a 30% chance of curing its own status conditions at the end of every turn by shedding its skin.

name: Guts
description: It’s so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat by 50%. Being burned does not halve the damage dealt by the Pokémon’s physical moves.

name: Marvel Scale
description: The Pokémon’s marvelous scales boost its Defense stat by 50% if it has a status condition.

name: Liquid Ooze
description: The strong stench of the Pokémon’s oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves instead of healing them.

name: Overgrow
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Grass-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

name: Blaze
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Fire-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

name: Torrent
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Water-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

name: Swarm
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Bug-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

name: Rock Head
description: The Pokémon will not lose HP due to recoil damage from its moves.

name: Drought
description: Summons harsh sunlight for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle. Powers up Fire-type moves by 50% and halves the damage of Water-type moves.

name: Arena Trap
description: Prevents opposing Pokémon from fleeing or switching out. Raises the likelihood of Double Battles while this Pokémon is on the field.

name: Vital Spirit
description: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from becoming drowsy or being put to sleep.

name: White Smoke
description: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents its stats from being lowered by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities.

name: Pure Power
description: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles the power of its physical moves.

name: Shell Armor
description: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

name: Air Lock
description: Eliminates the effects of weather.

name: Tangled Feet
description: Doubles the Pokémon’s evasiveness if it is confused.

name: Motor Drive
description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.

name: Rivalry
description: The Pokémon’s competitive spirit boosts the power of its moves by 25% against targets of the same gender, and lowers it by 25% against targets of the opposite gender. The power remains the same as usual if either Pokémon’s gender is unknown.

name: Steadfast
description: The Pokémon’s determination boosts its Speed stat when it flinches.

name: Snow Cloak
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s evasiveness by 25% in snow or hail. The Pokémon also takes no damage from hail.

name: Gluttony
description: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP drops to 1/4 or less of its max, it will instead eat that Berry when its HP drops to 1/2 or less of its max.

name: Anger Point
description: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

name: Unburden
description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat when its held item is consumed or lost.

name: Heatproof
description: The Pokémon’s heatproof body halves the damage taken from burns and Fire-type moves.

name: Simple
description: Doubles the effects of the Pokémon’s stat changes.

name: Dry Skin
description: Restores 1/4 of the Pokémon’s max HP when hit by Water-type moves or 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn in rain. However, the Pokémon receives 25% more damage from Fire-type moves and loses 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn in harsh sunlight.

name: Download
description: The Pokémon compares an opposing Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat — whichever will be more effective.

name: Iron Fist
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s punching moves by 20%.

name: Poison Heal
description: If poisoned or badly poisoned, the Pokémon has 1/8 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn instead of losing HP.

name: Adaptability
description: Boosts the power of moves of the same type as the Pokémon by 100% instead of 50%. Does not stack with the Stellar-type Tera boost.

name: Skill Link
description: The Pokémon’s multistrike moves always hit the max amount of times.

name: Hydration
description: Cures the Pokémon’s status conditions at the end of every turn in rain.

name: Solar Power
description: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 50% but it loses 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn.

name: Quick Feet
description: When the Pokémon has a status condition, its Speed stat is boosted by 50%. Being paralyzed does not lower the Pokémon’s Speed stat.

name: Normalize
description: All the Pokémon’s moves become Normal-type and their power is boosted by 20%.

name: Sniper
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s critical hits by 125% instead of 50%.

name: Magic Guard
description: The Pokémon takes damage only from attacks.

name: No Guard
description: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land. Raises the likelihood of Double Battles while this Pokémon is on the field.

name: Stall
description: The Pokémon’s moves go last among moves of the same priority.

name: Technician
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s moves by 50% if their power is 60 or less.

name: Leaf Guard
description: The Pokémon is immune to status conditions in harsh sunlight.

name: Klutz
description: Items do not work when held by the Pokémon.

name: Mold Breaker
description: The Pokémon’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

name: Super Luck
description: The Pokémon is so lucky that its moves have their critical-hit ratio boosted by 1 stage.

name: Aftermath
description: When the Pokémon is knocked out by a contact move, the attacker takes damage equal to 1/4 of their max HP.

name: Anticipation
description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it senses whether the opponents know any one-hit KO moves or moves that are super effective against it.

name: Forewarn
description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.

name: Unaware
description: The Pokémon ignores the target’s stat changes when attacking, and ignores the attacker’s stat changes when being attacked. It cannot ignore changes to the Speed stat, however.

name: Tinted Lens
description: The Pokémon’s “not very effective” attacks deal double damage.

name: Filter
description: Reduces the damage the Pokémon takes from super effective moves by 25%.

name: Slow Start
description: For five turns, the Pokémon’s Attack and Speed stats are halved.

name: Scrappy
description: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

name: Storm Drain
description: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves. These moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Sp. Atk stat.

name: Ice Body
description: The Pokémon has 1/16 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn in snow or hail. The Pokémon also takes no damage from hail.

name: Solid Rock
description: Reduces the damage the Pokémon takes from super effective moves by 25%.

name: Snow Warning
description: Summons snow for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle. Ice-type Pokemon have their Defense stat boosted by 50%.

name: Honey Gather
description: The Pokémon gathers Honey which is then sold for money after a battle is won, even if it did not participate.

name: Frisk
description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon’s Ability.

name: Reckless
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s moves by 20% if they have recoil or crash damage.

name: Multitype
description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the Plate it holds.

name: Flower Gift
description: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of the Pokémon and its allies by 50% in harsh sunlight.

name: Bad Dreams
description: Damages opposing Pokémon that are asleep at the end of every turn by 1/8 of their max HP.

name: Pickpocket
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, it will steal a held item from the attacker.

name: Sheer Force
description: The Pokémon’s moves lose their additional effects, but the power of those moves will be boosted by 30%.

name: Contrary
description: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them — and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.

name: Unnerve
description: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

name: Defiant
description: When the Pokémon has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Attack stat is boosted sharply.

name: Defeatist
description: Halves the Pokémon’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP drops to 1/2 or less.

name: Cursed Body
description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, the attacker has a 30% chance to have whichever move it last used disabled for 4 turns.

name: Healer
description: The Pokémon has a 50% chance of curing the status conditions of its allies at the end of every turn.

name: Friend Guard
description: Reduces the damage allies take by 25%.

name: Weak Armor
description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a physical move, its Defense stat is lowered, but its Speed stat is boosted sharply.

name: Heavy Metal
description: Doubles the Pokémon’s weight.

name: Light Metal
description: Halves the Pokémon’s weight.

name: Multiscale
description: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

name: Toxic Boost
description: When the Pokémon is poisoned or badly poisoned, the power of its physical moves is boosted by 50%.

name: Flare Boost
description: When the Pokémon is burned, the power of its special moves is boosted by 50%.

name: Harvest
description: If the Pokémon has used a Berry, it has a 50% chance of creating another one at the end of every turn. In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon is guaranteed to create a Berry.

name: Telepathy
description: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

name: Moody
description: At the end of every turn, one of the Pokémon’s stats will be boosted sharply, but another will be lowered. Accuracy and evasiveness are excluded.

name: Overcoat
description: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms or hail, and is immune to moves and Abilities involving powder or spores.

name: Poison Touch
description: When the Pokémon hits a target with a contact move, the target has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

name: Regenerator
description: The Pokémon has 1/3 of its max HP restored when it switches out of battle.

name: Big Pecks
description: The Pokémon’s Defense stat cannot be lowered by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities.

name: Sand Rush
description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat in a sandstorm. The Pokémon also takes no damage from sandstorms.

name: Wonder Skin
description: Lowers the accuracy of status moves used against the Pokémon to 50%.

name: Analytic
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s move by 30% when the Pokémon is the last to move that turn.

name: Illusion
description: The Pokémon fools opponents by entering battle disguised as the last Pokémon in its party. It reverts to its usual appearance when it takes damage from a move.

name: Imposter
description: The Pokémon transforms into the Pokémon in front of it. It also copies all of that Pokémon’s stats apart from its HP. Copied moves have 5 PP each.

name: Infiltrator
description: When using its moves, the Pokémon ignores the effects of targets’ Light Screen, Reflect, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, and substitutes.

name: Mummy
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has its Ability changed to Mummy.

name: Moxie
description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

name: Justified
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type move, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

name: Rattled
description: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.

name: Magic Bounce
description: Instead of being affected by other Pokémon’s status moves, the Pokémon bounces them back at the user.

name: Sap Sipper
description: Grass-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Attack stat.

name: Prankster
description: Increases the priority of the Pokémon’s status moves by 1 stage. However, the Pokémon’s status moves no longer work against Dark-type Pokémon.

name: Sand Force
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves by 30% in a sandstorm. The Pokémon also takes no damage from sandstorms.

name: Iron Barbs
description: The Pokémon’s iron barbs damage attackers that hit it with contact moves for 1/8 of their max HP.

name: Zen Mode
description: The Pokémon changes its form to Zen Mode when its HP drops to 1/2 or less.

name: Victory Star
description: The Pokémon and its allies have their accuracy boosted by 10%.

name: Turboblaze
description: The Pokémon’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

name: Teravolt
description: The Pokémon’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

name: Aroma Veil
description: The Pokémon and its allies are protected from Infatuation, Taunt, Torment, Disable, Heal Block, and Encore.

name: Flower Veil
description: If the Pokémon or its allies are Grass-type, they are immune to status conditions and cannot have their stats lowered.

name: Cheek Pouch
description: The Pokémon has 1/3 of its max HP restored when it eats a Berry, in addition to the Berry’s usual effect.

name: Protean
description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

name: Fur Coat
description: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from physical moves.

name: Magician
description: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.

name: Bulletproof
description: The Pokémon is immune to ball and bomb moves.

name: Competitive
description: When the Pokémon has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted sharply.

name: Strong Jaw
description: The Pokémon’s strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves by 50%.

name: Refrigerate
description: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

name: Sweet Veil
description: The Pokémon and its allies cannot become drowsy or be put to sleep.

name: Stance Change
description: The Pokémon changes into its Blade Forme when it attacks and changes into its Shield Forme when it uses the move King’s Shield.

name: Gale Wings
description: Increases the priority of the Pokémon’s Flying-type moves by 1 stage while its HP is full.

name: Mega Launcher
description: Boosts the power of Aura Sphere and moves with “Pulse” in their names by 50%.

name: Grass Pelt
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat by 50% on Grassy Terrain.

name: Symbiosis
description: When an ally consumes an item, the Pokémon gives its own held item to that ally.

name: Tough Claws
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s contact moves by 30%.

name: Pixilate
description: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

name: Gooey
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker’s Speed stat is lowered.

name: Aerilate
description: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

name: Parental Bond
description: When the Pokémon attacks, its kin follows up with a second strike at 1/4 of the first attack’s power. This does not occur for multistrike moves or moves that target multiple Pokémon.

name: Dark Aura
description: Boosts the power of the Dark-type moves of all Pokémon on the field by 33%.

name: Fairy Aura
description: Boosts the power of the Fairy-type moves of all Pokémon on the field by 33%.

name: Aura Break
description: The effects of Fairy Aura and Dark Aura are reversed and nullified, causing affected moves to be 25% weaker.

name: Primordial Sea
description: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks and increase the damage of Water-type moves by 50%.

name: Desolate Land
description: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks and increase the damage of Fire-type moves by 50%.

name: Delta Stream
description: The Pokémon changes the weather so that no moves are super effective against the Flying type.

name: Stamina
description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, its Defense stat is boosted.

name: Wimp Out
description: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP drops to 1/2 or less.

name: Emergency Exit
description: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP drops to 1/2 or less.

name: Water Compaction
description: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Pokémon is hit by a Water-type move.

name: Merciless
description: The Pokémon’s attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

name: Shields Down
description: The Pokémon’s shell protects it from status conditions. When its HP drops to 1/2 or less, the shell breaks and it becomes aggressive, changing into its Core Form.

name: Stakeout
description: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.

name: Water Bubble
description: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from Fire-type moves and doubles the power of its Water-type moves. The Pokémon cannot be burned.

name: Steelworker
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Steel-type moves by 50%.

name: Berserk
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat when an attack causes its HP to drop to 1/2 or less of its max.

name: Slush Rush
description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat in snow or hail. The Pokémon also takes no damage from hail.

name: Long Reach
description: None of the moves used by the Pokémon are considered contact moves.

name: Liquid Voice

name: Triage
description: Increases the priority of the Pokémon’s healing moves by 3 stages.

name: Galvanize

name: Surge Surfer
description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

name: Schooling
description: The Pokémon forms a powerful school when it reaches level 20. It stops schooling when its HP drops to 1/4 or less.

name: Disguise
description: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack at the cost of losing 1/8 of its max HP.

name: Battle Bond

name: Power Construct

name: Corrosion

name: Comatose
description: The Pokémon is always drowsing and can attack while in its sleeping state. It is considered under the effects of a status condition.

name: Queenly Majesty
description: The Pokémon’s majesty pressures opponents and makes them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

name: Innards Out
description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move that knocks it out, it deals the same amount of damage to the attacker.

name: Dancer
description: Whenever a dance move is used in battle, the Pokémon will copy the user to immediately perform that dance move itself.

name: Battery
description: Powers up special moves used by allies by 30%.

name: Fluffy
description: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

name: Dazzling
description: The Pokémon dazzles its opponents, making them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

name: Soul-Heart
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat every time another Pokémon faints.

name: Tangling Hair
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker’s Speed stat is lowered.

name: Receiver
description: The Pokémon changes its Ability to match that of a defeated ally in a Double Battle.

name: Power of Alchemy
description: The Pokémon changes its Ability to match that of a defeated ally in a Double Battle.

name: Beast Boost
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat every time it knocks out a target.

name: RKS System
description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.

name: Electric Surge

name: Psychic Surge

name: Misty Surge

name: Grassy Surge

name: Full Metal Body
description: The Pokémon’s stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities. This effect cannot be ignored.

name: Shadow Shield
description: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full. This effect cannot be ignored by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities.

name: Prism Armor

name: Neuroforce
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s moves that are super effective against the target by 25%.

name: Intrepid Sword
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

name: Dauntless Shield
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

name: Libero
description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

name: Ball Fetch
description: The Pokémon will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle, even if it did not participate.

name: Cotton Down
description: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.

name: Propeller Tail
description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

name: Mirror Armor
description: Instead of being affected by stat-lowering effects, the Pokémon bounces them back at whichever Pokémon caused them.

name: Gulp Missile
description: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it returns with prey. If the Pokémon is hit by a move, it spits out its prey at the attacker, dealing damage equal to 1/4 of the attacker’s max HP. This also lowers the attacker’s Defense stat or paralyzes it, depending on the caught prey.

name: Stalwart
description: The Pokémon ignores the effects of Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

name: Steam Engine
description: Boosts the Speed stat by 6 stages when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

name: Punk Rock
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s sound-based moves by 30% and halves the damage the Pokémon takes from sound-based moves.

name: Sand Spit
description: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns when the Pokémon takes damage from moves. Pokémon that are not Rock, Ground, or Steel types take damage equal to 1/16 of their max HP at the end of every turn. This also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types by 50%.

name: Ice Scales
description: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

name: Ripen
description: Ripens and doubles the effect of berries eaten by the Pokémon.

name: Ice Face
description: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, the ice will be restored when it begins to snow or hail.

name: Power Spot
description: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up the moves of its allies by 30%.

name: Mimicry
description: The Pokémon’s type changes depending on the terrain.

name: Screen Cleaner
description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

name: Steely Spirit
description: Boosts the power of Steel-type moves used by the Pokémon and its allies by 50%.

name: Perish Body
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle. Boss Pokémon are immune to this effect.

name: Wandering Spirit
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, it swaps Abilities with the attacker.

name: Gorilla Tactics
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat by 50%, but only allows the use of the first selected move.

name: Neutralizing Gas
description: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon’s Abilities and Passives will be nullified or will not be triggered.

name: Pastel Veil
description: The Pokémon and its allies are protected from being poisoned or badly poisoned.

name: Hunger Switch
description: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.

name: Quick Draw
description: The Pokémon’s moves have a 30% chance of going first among moves of the same priority.

name: Unseen Fist
description: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target’s protective effects is still triggered.

name: Curious Medicine
description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

name: Transistor
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Electric-type moves by 30%.

name: Dragon’s Maw
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Dragon-type moves by 50%.

name: Chilling Neigh
description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

name: Grim Neigh
description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

name: As One
description: This Ability combines the effects of both Unnerve and Chilling Neigh, preventing opposing Pokémon from consuming berries and boosting the Pokémon’s Attack stat when knocking out a target.

name: As One
description: This Ability combines the effects of both Unnerve and Grim Neigh, preventing opposing Pokémon from consuming berries and boosting the Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat when knocking out a target.

name: Lingering Aroma
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has its Ability changed to Lingering Aroma.

name: Seed Sower
description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon takes damage from moves. Pokémon on the ground have their Grass-type moves boosted by 30% and restore 1/16 of their max HP at the end of every turn.

name: Thermal Exchange
description: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

name: Anger Shell
description: When an attack causes its HP to drop to 1/2 or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

name: Purifying Salt
description: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

name: Well-Baked Body
description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

name: Wind Rider
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

name: Guard Dog
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

name: Rocky Payload
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Rock-type moves by 50%.

name: Wind Power
description: The Pokémon becomes charged when Tailwind takes effect or it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

name: Zero to Hero
description: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out of battle.

name: Commander
description: Upon entering battle, the Pokémon goes inside an ally Dondozo if one is on the field and raises all its stats sharply. Raises the likelihood of Double Battles while this Pokémon is on the field.

name: Electromorphosis
description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, the power of the next Electric-type move used by the Pokémon will be doubled.

name: Protosynthesis
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is its Speed stat.

name: Quark Drive
description: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is its Speed stat.

name: Good as Gold
description: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.

name: Vessel of Ruin
description: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself by 25% while on the field.

name: Sword of Ruin
description: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself by 25% while on the field.

name: Tablets of Ruin
description: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself by 25% while on the field.

name: Beads of Ruin
description: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself by 25% while on the field.

name: Orichalcum Pulse
description: Summons harsh sunlight for 5 turns when entering a battle, which powers up Fire-type moves by 50% and halves the power of Water-type moves. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat by 33% in harsh sunlight.

name: Hadron Engine
description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when entering a battle, which powers up the Electric-type moves of Pokémon on the ground by 30% and prevents them from falling asleep. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat by 33% on Electric Terrain.

name: Opportunist
description: When an opponent’s stats are boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost its own stats in the exact same way.

name: Cud Chew
description: If the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate and eat that same Berry once more at the end of next turn.

name: Sharpness
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s slicing moves by 50%.

name: Supreme Overlord
description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the power of its moves is boosted by 10% for each Pokémon in its party that has been defeated in battle already. The maximum boost is 50%

name: Costar
description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies its ally’s stat changes.

name: Toxic Debris
description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves. Opposing Pokémon that land on these spikes when switching into battle will be poisoned. A second layer of spikes will instead badly poison. Poison-types that land on these spikes will absorb and remove them from the field.

name: Armor Tail
description: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon’s head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

name: Earth Eater
description: Ground-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.

name: Mycelium Might
description: The Pokémon’s status moves will go last among moves of the same priority, but these moves will be unaffected by the Ability of the target.

name: Mind’s Eye
description: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents’ evasiveness, its accuracy can’t be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

name: Supersweet Syrup
description: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field when the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.

name: Hospitality
description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring 1/4 of its ally’s max HP.

name: Toxic Chain
description: When the Pokémon hits a target with a move, the target has a 30% chance of being badly poisoned from the power of the Pokémon’s toxic chain.

name: Embody Aspect
description: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Teal Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Speed stat to be boosted.

name: Embody Aspect
description: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Wellspring Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Sp. Def stat to be boosted.

name: Embody Aspect
description: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Hearthflame Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Attack stat to be boosted.

name: Embody Aspect
description: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Cornerstone Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Defense stat to be boosted.

name: Tera Shift
description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

name: Tera Shell
description: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

name: Teraform Zero
description: The Pokémon uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

name: Poison Puppeteer
description: Pokémon poisoned or badly poisoned by this Pokémon’s moves will also become confused.

name: Piercing Drill
description: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target’s protective effects is still triggered.

name: Dragonize
description: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

name: Eelevate
description: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

name: Mega Sol
description: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

name: Fire Mane
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Fire-type moves by 50%.

name: Spicy Spray
description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

name: Aura Guard
description: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact.
